precision: The log prints median and p95 to two decimal places via toFixed(2). Raw sample values and full-precision statistics were not retrieved.

workload.glyphCountLimitation: Not exposed by the bridge; input character counts are not substituted for actual shaped/drawn glyph totals.

sampling.medianDefinition: Average of the two middle sorted durations for the even 36-sample set.
sampling.p95Definition: Nearest-rank sorted duration at ceil(sampleCount * 0.95), using one-based rank.

measurement.start: Node-side performance.now immediately before Playwright mouse.move.
measurement.end: Node-side performance.now after waitForFunction observes a larger native renderedFrames counter and the expected camera position.
included: native input handling and work until the observed frame counter advances
bridge state serialization and parsing used by the wait predicate
measurement.subsequentAnimationCallbacks: Two requestAnimationFrame callbacks form a separately recorded settling observation; those settling metrics were not printed or retrieved here.

sourceEnforcedPostconditionsBeforePrinti: Every label remains visible during each measured pan.
Panning preserves the authored document revision and final exported document hash.
Render panic, page error, and console error arrays are asserted empty before the successful line is printed.

verificationLimit.explanation: The two rounded log lines and the exact-commit method source are verified. Original benchmark JSON, sample arrays, runtime fingerprints and device details remain unavailable because artifact bytes were not downloaded.

interpretation: The observed WebGL2 p95 is 1366.94 ms on this CI workload. These results do not establish uniformly low browser latency, physical-GPU throughput, FPS, or a speedup over another build.
